snippet: May 6, 2024 · A HHD (hybrid hard drive) or HHDD (hybrid hard disk drive) is a storage device that is a combination of an SSD (solid-state drive) and an HDD (hard disk drive). Its intended purpose is to bring together the performance of an SSD with the affordability and high capacity of an HDD.

snippet: Rechunk Rechunk is a library for reprocessing an OSTree OCI image prior to distribution (e.g., right after making it). It flattens the file system tree, thereby removing files that were replaced in later OCI layers, then re-partitions the image into a set of N equally sized layers through a grouping algorithm. These layers are then fed to ostree-rs-ext, which produces a new equivalent OSTree ...
